predictions.reason: Communication with care team is universally required regardless of age.
D5W hypotonicity after metabolism is a general pharmacological fact.
Isotonic fluids for mild dehydration apply to all ages.
Fluid deficit calculation becomes more critical in older adults due to comorbidities or renal function changes.
D5W vs normal saline distinction is age-independent.
Mismatch resolution via prescriber discussion is universal.
Differences between fluids are factual and age-agnostic.
Assessment of patient status is more critical in older adults due to polypharmacy or comorbidities.
Accuracy and completeness are universal requirements.
Instruction following is consistent across ages.

proposed_induced: Assess renal function and polypharmacy in patients aged 72+ for fluid management
Evaluate geriatric falls risk in patients aged 72+ due to dehydration
Check for growth/developmental considerations in patients aged 8-30
Involve guardians for patients aged 8-30 if decision-making capacity is unclear
